short_description: Enterprise telehealth platform serving health systems, insurers, and employers with white-label virtual care solutions, including behavioral health and psychiatry.
long_description: Amwell (American Well Corporation) is one of the leading enterprise telehealth platforms in the US, providing white-label virtual care solutions to health systems, health plans, and employers. Founded in 2006, the publicly traded company (NYSE: AMWL) offers the Converge platform, which enables organizations to deliver virtual care across multiple specialties including urgent care, behavioral health, chronic care management, and specialty consultations. Amwell supports both synchronous video visits and asynchronous care, integrates with major EHR systems, and offers AI-powered clinical decision support. The platform powers telehealth for major health systems and insurance companies, serving millions of members. Amwell acquired SilverCloud Health in 2021 to strengthen its digital mental health offerings.

faqs.q: Is Amwell for individual providers or enterprises?
faqs.a: Amwell is primarily an enterprise platform designed for health systems, insurers, and employers. Individual providers typically access Amwell through their healthcare organization or as part of the Amwell provider network, rather than purchasing directly.

faqs.q: Does Amwell offer mental health services?
faqs.a: Yes. Amwell provides comprehensive behavioral health services including therapy, psychiatry, and medication management. In 2021, Amwell acquired SilverCloud Health, adding digital CBT and mental health tools to its platform.

Enterprise pricing is customized based on organization needs. Consumer visits through Amwell Now or insurance typically cost $79-99 for general medical, $85-150 for therapy, and $199-250 for initial psychiatry consultations.

faqs.q: What EHR systems does Amwell integrate with?
faqs.a: Amwell integrates with major EHR systems including Epic, Cerner (Oracle Health), MEDITECH, Allscripts, and athenahealth. The Converge platform supports HL7/FHIR standards for deep integration.
